from tbparse import SummaryReader
import pandas as pd
r = SummaryReader('logdir/exp_026_obs_sgs_cheetah_s0/')

er = df[df['tag']=='scalars/eval_return'][['step','value']].rename(columns={'value':'eval_return'})
merged = pd.merge(vm, er, on='step', how='inner').sort_values('step')
merged['ve_ratio'] = merged['value_mean'] / merged['eval_return']
print(merged.to_string(index=False))
print(f'\nMax step: {merged.step.max()}')
peak = merged[merged.step>=35000]
if len(peak):
    pidx = peak.ve_ratio.idxmax()
    p = merged.loc[pidx]
    print(f'Peak ve_ratio: {p.ve_ratio:.4f} @ step {int(p.step)}')
final = merged[merged.step == merged.step.max()].iloc[0]
print(f'Final ve_ratio: {final.ve_ratio:.4f} @ step {int(final.step)}')
print(f'Final value_mean: {final.value_mean:.2f}, Final eval_return: {final.eval_return:.2f}')
"
